title: Travel level 4

artwork.concept: A small grocery storefront with a dominant shopping cart and shelves of packaged food visible through the wide entrance.

reviewNotes: Keep distinct from the open-air market and bakery; do not add fruit piles as the primary subject.

artwork.concept: A post-office counter and compact facade with a dominant envelope pictogram and mail slot.

reviewNotes: Use an envelope symbol, not text; avoid a generic shop that depends on a label.

artwork.concept: A compact police-station facade with a large shield badge above the entrance.

reviewNotes: No police car outside: keep separate from patrulla; do not rely on written signs.

artwork.concept: A quiet library interior with two tall bookshelves and a reading table; books dominate.

reviewNotes: Keep clearly different from the standalone table card; no bookstore checkout.

artwork.concept: A cinema interior with a large blank screen, rows of red seats and a film-reel pictogram.

reviewNotes: No popcorn or snacks as the primary cue.

artwork.concept: A small laundry interior with two large front-loading washing machines and a basket of clothes.

reviewNotes: No detergent bottle as the main object; distinguish from a hotel room.

artwork.concept: One complete helicopter with a clear large main rotor and tail rotor, seen in side three-quarter view.

reviewNotes: No airplane, pad scene or incidental vehicle; review rotor readability at card size.

artwork.concept: One large cargo truck with an obvious enclosed cargo box behind its cab, seen side-on.

reviewNotes: The full phrase avoids the Mexican bus sense of camión. Exclude bus/car/ambulance/patrol-car choices where needed.

artwork.concept: One white emergency ambulance with a blue medical star and a clear rooftop light bar.

reviewNotes: No lettering, brand or protected red-cross emblem; keep distinct from the hospital picture and ordinary van.

artwork.concept: One dark-and-white patrol car with a clear rooftop emergency light bar and shield badge pictogram.

reviewNotes: Vehicle sense; not a group of officers. Compare with carro and police-station artwork before activation.

artwork.concept: One large upright black rubber tire with a clear tread and hollow center, no metal rim.

reviewNotes: Rubber tire sense used in Mexico and much of Latin America; not a wheel rim. Avoid competing vehicle pictures containing prominent tires.

artwork.concept: One isolated circular three-spoke steering wheel with a small central hub.

reviewNotes: No dashboard, tire tread or car around it; compare with llanta for clear silhouettes.

artwork.concept: A compact transparent salt shaker with a perforated metal top and visible white salt grains.

reviewNotes: Salt and sugar cannot be distinguished by the granules alone; container cues must remain clear.

artwork.concept: A rounded sugar bowl containing distinct white sugar cubes, with one small spoon.

reviewNotes: Keep distinct from the salt shaker; do not reuse the standalone spoon picture.

artwork.concept: A smooth pale-yellow rectangular butter stick on an open butter dish with one thin slice.

reviewNotes: No cheese holes or wedge shape; inspect/exclude the cheese card and plate card if still ambiguous.

artwork.concept: One round green lime with a clearly visible cut half showing pale-green citrus segments.

reviewNotes: Green lime sense for Mexican vocabulary focus, not a yellow lemon; compare with naranja and aguacate.

artwork.concept: One large red strawberry with a leafy green cap and clearly visible seeds.

reviewNotes: Single fruit, no bowl, yogurt, cake or market scene.

artwork.concept: One whole golden pineapple with a clear diamond-patterned skin and tall green crown.

reviewNotes: Single fruit; no drink, fruit basket or beach scene.

artwork.concept: One ankle sock with a clear heel, toe and ribbed cuff.

reviewNotes: Singular; no shoe or pair of socks. Distinguish from guante.

artwork.concept: One simple flared knee-length skirt with an obvious waistband and open lower hem.

reviewNotes: No torso, sleeves or trouser legs; distinguish from vestido and pantalones.

artwork.concept: One sleeveless knee-length dress with a connected bodice and flared skirt.

reviewNotes: No person; silhouette must differ from falda, camisa and traje de baño.

artwork.concept: One simple glove with all five fingers distinct and an obvious wrist cuff.

reviewNotes: Singular; no mitten or hand inside it. Avoid a medical setting that narrows the word unnecessarily.

artwork.concept: One brown clothing belt curved into a loose oval, with a clear metal buckle and punched holes.

reviewNotes: Clothing belt, not the already-taught seat belt. Compare/exclude cinturón de seguridad.

artwork.concept: One wristwatch with a large round dial and clearly visible upper/lower straps.

reviewNotes: No wall clock, numerals or text needed; full phrase makes the wristwatch sense explicit.

artwork.concept: One large round tablet with a shallow score line and a small simple blister backing behind it.

reviewNotes: A medicine tablet, not candy or soap; do not depict dosage instructions.

artwork.concept: One unwrapped beige adhesive strip with two rounded ends and an obvious central gauze pad.

reviewNotes: Common American word; no brand logo. Clearly different from a roll of bandage.

artwork.concept: A white rolled gauze bandage with a broad loose tail and visible soft woven texture.

reviewNotes: Roll of bandage, not toilet paper, towel or adhesive strip; compare with those earlier cards.

artwork.concept: One large pair of scissors with two finger loops, a clear central pivot and two slightly open blades.

reviewNotes: Plural noun for one pair. Existing cutting-action scene includes equally prominent paper, so plan a noun-focused illustration.

artwork.concept: One broad squeeze tube with a large simple sun pictogram and a small dab of cream at its tip.

reviewNotes: Sun icon must read at 145px; no SPF lettering. Compare with toothpaste, shampoo and insect-repellent packaging.

artwork.concept: One spray bottle with a clear mosquito pictogram inside a crossed circle.

reviewNotes: Mosquito symbol must remain readable without words. Compare with sunscreen, shampoo and bottle cards.

artwork.concept: One small dome camping tent with a clearly open triangular entrance and short guy ropes.

reviewNotes: No shop facade; full phrase distinguishes tent from tienda meaning shop.

artwork.concept: One handheld flashlight with a broad lens and a short gentle beam showing its function.

reviewNotes: No batteries or phone beside it; keep complete handle and lens visible.

artwork.concept: One round compass with a prominent two-color needle and four simple directional ticks.

reviewNotes: No letters, numbers or map; distinguish from a wristwatch by needle and absence of straps.

artwork.concept: One elongated padded sleeping bag, partly unzipped to show its hollow opening and attached hood.

reviewNotes: No bed or pillow. Must look like a sleeping bag rather than a folded blanket or scarf.

artwork.concept: One pair of binoculars with two round objective lenses joined by a central bridge and focus wheel.

reviewNotes: Plural noun; no neck strap dominating the silhouette or scenic background.

artwork.concept: One pink five-petaled flower with a yellow center, green stem and two leaves.

reviewNotes: Reuse the exact approved standalone flower; no bouquet, vase or garden.

lexicalReferences.note: Police vehicle sense explicitly includes Mexico and many American varieties.

lexicalReferences.title: ASALE: curita
lexicalReferences.note: Adhesive strip sense used across many American varieties; no brand is drawn.

lexicalReferences.title: Mexican Ministry of Agriculture: limón mexicano
lexicalReferences.note: Green-fruit Mexican lime example supporting the intended picture sense.

inspectedRejected.reason: Cutting-action picture includes an equally prominent sheet of paper; plan isolated scissors.
